gloss_en: kaneh — the reed/cane (which is also the windpipe, the hollow reed-like channel from which the voice issues): the symbolic reed of the aggadah 'Gabriel planted a reed in the sea,' expounded both as the throat producing voice (LM 1:5) and as wisdoms — holy ('acquire wisdom,' keneh chokhmah) versus the reed of the kelipot, external wisdoms ('rebuke the beast of the reeds') (LM 1:35); NOT the verb קָנָה 'to acquire' itself, though the homophony with קְנֵה is the basis of the wordplay
